feature_contract.pooling_accumulation: convert final-layer token vectors to float32, then arithmetic-mean across the complete model-visible sequence

cache_contract.tensor_file: features-v01.f32le; row-major [65536,2048] contiguous float32 little-endian values.

row_receipt.row_id: SHA-256 of UTF-8 'FAS_FEATURE_ROW_V1\0' || event_id || '\0' || input_view || '\0' || lowercase input_utf8_sha256.
row_receipt.token_ids_sha256: SHA-256 of bytes 'FAS_TOKEN_IDS_V1\0' || uint64_le(token_count) || each token ID as uint32_le in model input order.
row_receipt.feature_sha256: SHA-256 of the row's contiguous 2048 float32 little-endian feature bytes; reject NaN and infinity before serialization.

determinism_smoke.sample_selection: Sort unique event IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8 'FAS_PHASE2A_REPEAT_V01\0' || event_id; select the first 32 IDs; include both input views.
determinism_smoke.procedure: Before full extraction, forward each selected row twice under the same frozen runtime and compare token IDs, lengths, float32 feature bytes, and hashes byte-for-byte.
determinism_smoke.mismatch_disposition: FAIL_CLOSED; do not extract the remaining corpus.
